Hold SPACE longer to cast farther · A/D steer when a fish runs · H eat · T traps · V first person · E go inside / open chests · B boat · R ride 4-wheeler · X scope · Y drone · F fireworks · M missions · P photo · K track · N map · C animal call · Z binoculars

Lake Life

Explore a huge map with lakes, rivers, creeks, islands and secret spots. Catch fish, sell them, and mount your best ones in your cabin.

Walk into the shop for rods, reels, line, hooks, lures, boats and clothes. Hunt for treasure, legendary fish and boss fish!

12 worlds (even a cave and the Moon!) · 87 kinds of fish · hunting, 4-wheelers & drones · seasons & ice fishing · a story with Grandpa Joe!

On a phone: left joystick walks, hold the yellow button to cast (longer = farther) and to shoot. When a fish runs, push the joystick the other way! Tap 🏠 to go inside or open treasure. Tap ❤️ to eat food. Tap 👁️ for first person. Turn your phone sideways to see more!
